in_sanskrit.name: मयूर
in_sanskrit.meaning: पेड़ में वह पत्र जिसका नाम है जिससे पढ़ता हुआ विकसित होता है, यानि मायूर पत्र (Peacock feather)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The feather that blooms when it is read out, i.e., Mayur Patra (Peacock feather)

in_tamil.name: மயுர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The spreading, wide branch or tree

in_telugu.name: మెయూర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who blooms like a peacock

in_marathi.name: Mayur
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mayur हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mayur is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Mayura' which means peacock. In Hindu mythology, the peacock is considered a sacred bird, symbolizing wealth, prosperity, and the grace of the gods. The name Mayur is believed to bring good fortune and joy.
